text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to accomplish. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, the actual products or results you hand over, should be clearly described from the start. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters: everyone involved must agree on the goals, so there are no surprises later. When all these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly and teams feel more confident.
